mcat_description.short: Portable Cabin (also called Porta Cabin) is a prefabricated, relocatable structure built on a steel frame with insulated sandwich panel walls and roof, sold as a complete unit or per sq ft for site offices, security posts, accommodation, storage, and commercial use.
mcat_description.long: Portable cabins are factory-manufactured prefabricated structures comprising a structural steel (MS/GI) frame, insulated sandwich panels (PUF, EPS, or rock wool core), aluminium-framed windows, steel or PVC doors, and metal roofing — assembled off-site and installed on location within hours. They are designed for easy relocation, modular expansion, and long-term durability (10–20 years) across construction sites, industrial facilities, and commercial environments. In the Indian market, the dominant construction method uses mild steel or galvanised steel frames with PUF or EPS sandwich panels, and cabins are available in standard sizes (e.g. 10×10 ft, 10×20 ft, 20×40 ft) as well as fully custom dimensions. Key buyer-facing attributes include panel insulation type, frame material grade, floor load capacity, wind resistance rating, and IS standard compliance.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Porta Cabin' and 'Portable Cabin' are used interchangeably — 'porta cabin' is the dominant trade term in buyer search vocabulary (highest Google impressions). The standard construction method uses a mild steel (MS) or galvanised iron (GI) structural frame with insulated sandwich panels (PUF, EPS, or rock wool core), aluminium sliding windows, and metal roofing, built to IS standards per leading manufacturers including EPACK Prefab, Pressmach, Metal Tree, and KMS Technologies. Key product variants are differentiated by panel type (PUF vs EPS vs rock wool), frame material (MS vs GI), and application (office, security, accommodation, storage, commercial). The market spans construction, infrastructure, mining, oil & gas, and commercial sectors, with construction site offices and security cabins being the highest-volume sub-types. Cabins are sold per piece for standard sizes and per sq ft for custom builds; lifespan is typically 10–20 years with proper maintenance. Delhi-NCR, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Pune, and Vadodara are prominent manufacturing hubs.
